attempts.summary: Created appworker user on node1 and set session limits (8192 open files, 256 processes) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified limits with an actual login shell (sudo -i -u appworker ulimit). Completed mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, restarted node1 with systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified the account and limits post-restart.
